_comment: Reviewed high/critical advisories that are accepted for now. Each entry must be re-justified or removed by 'reviewBy'. See docs/13 section 14.

exceptions.path: expo -> @expo/cli/@expo/metro -> metro -> metro-file-map -> micromatch -> braces; react-native -> @react-native/community-cli-plugin -> metro; jest -> @jest/core -> micromatch -> braces
exceptions.why: Stack exhaustion on deeply nested glob patterns. Used by Metro/Jest on the developer's or CI machine to match project files; not part of the app bundle and not fed untrusted patterns. No patched braces release exists.
RSA signature verification flaw in Expo CLI code-signing tooling that runs on the build machine; not in the app bundle. Offered fix is a nonsensical downgrade to expo@44.
